page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance features 2 dedicated physical CPU cores with 1 thread per core, providing 2 vCPUs in total. It is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a balanced configuration for general-purpose workloads. Because the CPU allocation is dedicated rather than shared or burstable, it provides stable compute performance without CPU credit limitations. This makes the instance suitable for lightweight web serving, small databases, development environments, and basic application hosting where consistent, non-burstable CPU performance is required.
